summary.text: Corey Rosenlee is the Democratic candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 39, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Daniel Degracia.
He also ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024, losing to Republican Elijah Pierick both times.

paragraphs.text: Corey Rosenlee won the Democratic primary for District 39 in 2022, defeating Jamaica Cullen and Kevin Kupihea Wilson, and lost the general election to Elijah Pierick on November 8, 2022.
He won the Democratic primary again in 2024, defeating Reginald Kawena Garcia, and lost to incumbent Pierick in the general election on November 5, 2024.
In 2026 he defeated Loren Doctolero in the August 8 Democratic primary.
